interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: The repair drive time and location aren’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Oren relies on clear reminders and responds well to specific time/place details.
Quinn is coordinating the repair drive and actively recruiting help.
Rey prefers a light commitment and is willing to contribute informally.
Quinn is a reliable organizer who coordinates tasks, communication, and on-site logistics for the repair drive.
Oren prefers clear reminders and practical details, and is willing to help once the plan is spelled out.
Rey is supportive and collaborative, trusting Quinn to match volunteers to jobs and help make sure the work is covered.
Quinn is a dependable organizer who coordinates tasks, tools, and volunteer routing for the repair drive.
Rey is cooperative and task-oriented, and values direct follow-through on matching people to jobs and covering gaps.
Oren and Ira are receptive supporters: Oren is eager to participate, and Ira is willing to help spread the word.
Quinn is the coordination hub for the repair drive, routing people to tasks and time/place details.
Rey is organizing labor at the shed and values having helpers matched to specific jobs.
The group responds reliably to direct requests, with Dane and Ira each taking on supportive roles.
Quinn is coordinating a practical repair drive and responds quickly with concrete next steps.
Dane is dependable and willing to help with materials and hands-on work, especially for the shed and fence panels.
Pia and Hana are interested volunteers who need clear logistics or task guidance to join effectively.

events.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help, I just need a little reminder of what we’re fixing and when to show up.
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: We’re fixing up the community shed and a few loose fence panels this Saturday morning. Come by around 10 and I’ll point you to the tools.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Oren: Got it — community shed and fence panels this Saturday around 10. I’ll be there, and if I forget, I’ll ask you again!
events.speaker: Oren

events.text: Quinn: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put you down to help or just come by?
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Just come by—I can help out for a bit.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Rey: That’d be a big help—if you can, please match folks to the right jobs and let me know who still needs a hand.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll match folks to jobs and keep an eye on who still needs help. I’ll also send anyone extra straight to the shed around 10 on Saturday.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn—that really helps. I’ll be at the shed around 10 on Saturday.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: We’re fixing up the community shed and a few loose fence panels this Saturday morning. Come by around 10 and I’ll point you to the tools.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let folks know about the repair drive.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Ira! If you hear anyone interested, send them my way or have them swing by the shed around 10 on Saturday.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Dane: I’m still here to help — what’s the biggest thing you need done for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: The community shed is the big one, plus a few loose fence panels. If you can come by around 10 this Saturday, I’ll point you to the tools.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Dane: I can do 10 this Saturday — I’ll bring the screws and duct tape and help with the shed and fence panels.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Quinn: I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put you down to help, or would you rather just come by?
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Pia: I can come by, but could you send me the exact location and what time we’re starting? I just want to make sure I can plan the drive over.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the exact spot and start time right away. Thanks for coming by!
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: I can help with that—what should I bring for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Quinn: Awesome — if you can, bring a few basic tools and whatever supplies you already have, and I’ll make sure people know we could use hands-on help too.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll bring a few basic tools and whatever supplies I already have. And I’ll keep an eye out for hands-on help too.
events.speaker: Hana
